text:
Elena (People Ops): FYI SF hub folks  HVAC compressor failure reported. Building mgmt is closing floors 2-7 today (Mar 25) starting ~14:00. Do not come on-site until we update. We'll run a short contingency plan for the next two days.

Marcus (Facilities): Confirmed. Contractors on site. Air-quality testing in progress. Initial ETA for limited access: Fri evening, but could stretch to Mon. I'll post updates.

Jordan (Eng): I have the demo rack on floor 4. Can I pull it out?

Marcus (Facilities): For critical hardware only: escorted retrieval window 15:00-17:00 today. Sign-up link (internal). Badges required. Slots limited to 10 people.

Priya (Design): I have candidate interviews at 16:00. Should I switch to Zoom?

Elena (People Ops): Yes please move interviews virtual. Recruiting will auto-notify candidates; if you need an in-person alternative we'll book a partner space. Use the form for a paid coworking pass.

Kaito (Security): Access control note: affected floors are locked by building security. If you badge in, you'll be redirected to the lobby and escorted out. No tailgating. Report anything suspicious to Security.

OfficeBot: Incident logged: INC-2026-331 (SF HVAC). Push notification sent to #all-sf.

Jordan (Eng): Quick Q: I commuted in this morning from Napa. Any hotel help if I want to stay local tonight?

Elena (People Ops): Yes  if you traveled >75 miles to be on-site today, we'll cover one-night hotel up to $150. Submit receipts within 7 days and tag "SF HVAC" in expense notes. If you need same-day flight rebook help, open a ticket with Travel.

Marcus (Facilities): Personal items: if you left plants, monitors, or whiteboards on affected floors we'll secure them in our storage room. We'll label and lock. Claim window next Tue. If you need immediate access, use the retrieval sign-up.

Priya (Design): Accessibility check: I need a quiet place to run usability sessions and can't work from home effectively. Any options?

Elena (People Ops): We reserved quiet work rooms at WeWork Mission for up to 6 people/day for accessibility and sensitive work. Mark "quiet" on the coworking request form; priority to neurodivergent and ADA requests.

Kaito (Security): Device handling: if you want us to store company gear overnight, include serial numbers in the retrieval/storage form. We'll provide a chain-of-custody receipt at dropoff.

Elena (People Ops): Expense snippet to paste into Concur/expensify:
```
Expense: Hotel
Amount: $120.00 USD
Date: 2026-03-25
Category: Travel - Emergency hub closure
Notes: SF HVAC closure - one-night hotel
```

OfficeBot: Coworking/capacity form posted: REF-SF-HVAC-2026. Deadline for requests: 2026-03-26 12:00 PDT.

Jordan (Eng): Appreciate the fast coordination.

Elena (People Ops): We'll follow up with a short all-staff email and an FAQ in #people-ops. DM People Ops for special accommodations or if you need priority retrieval. Stay safe and avoid the building until Marcus posts "all-clear." :shield:
